finding: TailorResult's validating initialiser gave the new matchedTagNames bound a default of [], so any caller omitting it built a result whose allowedSkills intersected with nothing — the match-bound silently unenforced
fix: Dropped the default; matchedTagNames is now required, so every call site states its bound. Updated the TailorView preview and cv-export's five render-test call sites

finding: cv-export's render tests constructed TailorResult through its validating initialiser, so a Tailor-internal validation change forced lockstep edits across the feature boundary
fix: Added a Tailor-owned makeTailorResult fixture in TailorFlowTests.swift; cv-export's five call sites now build results through it

finding: the three [CVEXPORT-65] tests asserted ReadingMeasureView.cappedWidth, a computed property nothing forces body to consume — deleting the cap or the centring frame left the whole suite green
fix: added two ImageRenderer pixel assertions rendering the container at the sheet's floor with .leading alignment (a fixed .frame(width:) centres by default and would mask a missing centring frame); both mutants verified to go red

finding: TailorView's ReadingMeasureView(spendsFullWidth:) call is the only site wiring the CV preview's exemption, and no test reaches it — inverting the flag capped the preview at 720, leaving its page pane 380 against A4's 595.2, with everything green
fix: added a verify check pinning the call's exact positive form; confirmed it breaches when the flag is inverted

finding: two unconnected 720pt reading measures — TailorFlowSheetMetrics.readingMeasure and a bare literal in ProfilePageView — drifting independently, with the shared container scoped inside a slice that owns the CV page
fix: moved ReadingMeasureView to Shared/DesignSystem with a ReadingMeasure.width constant both callers now read; tests stayed in CVExport/src because speccle claims only discovers tests inside slice folders

finding: isShowingCVPreview restated by hand the export == nil / !isComposing conditions the case .review chain already establishes, so the width flag and the phase drawn could silently disagree once an arm was added
fix: replaced it with previewSpendingFullWidth: CVPreviewModel?, which both the wrapper's flag and the preview arm now read — one expression decides

finding: a comment warned that dropping the outer frame would strand every phase at the leading edge, but both call sites wrap in frames whose alignment already defaults to .center
fix: deleted the comment; the behaviour it guarded is now defended by a render assertion instead

finding: capping the whole phase also caps its footer action bar, so the band stops 190pt short of each edge and the primary button jumps sideways entering the CV preview
fix: none — ruled deliberate by the human on the rendered frames; the bar stays inside the measure

finding: TourSeed.plantBare's doc comment restated the body — 'the role carries no achievements and there are no projects' says what the four lines below it show
fix: cut the restating clause, kept the decision (why a separate seed) and the purpose (what it makes start() do)

finding: TailorView's three phase arms each wire a phase to a TailorProgressView step, and nothing reaches the switch — no test constructs TailorView, and SnapshotGallery renders TailorProgressView(step:) directly over Step.allCases, so the PNGs are byte-identical however the arms are wired; swapping .scanning and .tailoring leaves the sheet saying "Laying your CV out…" while it scans, with the whole suite green
fix: added a verify check pinning each of the three arms to its matching step, as three independent lookaheads so the switch's case order stays free to change; confirmed it breaches on each arm mutated separately, while the sibling reading-measure check on the same file stayed green

finding: the remedy recorded for view-wiring-untested-at-call-site described the check as pinning the arms "in order", but the artefact that landed uses independent lookaheads so case order stays free — a future recall would have been told to rebuild the order-coupled shape that was deliberately rejected
fix: reverted the uncommitted record and re-ran remedy record with prose matching the artefact; recorded before landing, so no false entry was ever committed

finding: the streaming switch left responseText(from:) and MessagesResponse standing with no production caller, and [CVIMPORT-19]'s service test was the only thing holding them alive
fix: deleted both and repointed the [CVIMPORT-19] test at assembledText(fromEventBytes:) with a recorded max_tokens stream

finding: [TAILOR-70] and ADR 0009 said narration costs summary output tokens, one clause after correctly saying thinking is billed the same either way
fix: corrected the rationale in SPEC.md, ADR 0009 and the FitPassTests assertion message — display controls visibility only, so the default is the narrower request, not a saving

finding: [TAILOR-70] and ADR 0009 named seven non-narrating callers; there are eight — PipelineBoard's JobImportStore was already missing on the day it landed
fix: replaced the roll-call with the rule: every caller but the tailor run and the JD scan leaves it unset

finding: Tailor CONTEXT.md's new Delta entry banned 'event' while the same change set used it ten times for the SSE frame
fix: qualified the _Avoid_ the way root CONTEXT.md's Stage entry does — the SSE event is the carrier, not the Delta

finding: [TAILOR-72]'s test asserts timeoutInterval == 60, which URLRequest(url:) already defaults to, so deleting the assignment leaves it green
fix: authored an oracle verify check requiring the assignment, since no assertion on the value can catch its deletion

finding: [TAILOR-71]'s tour-service test asserted only that the result was some JSON, so it would pass on the wrong fixture
fix: added the two assertions its siblings carry — result equals the unstreamed answer, and the delta callback never fired
